newsitem.title: UK: OPEC members say output fell to 25.39 mbpd in May.
newsitem.headline: OPEC members say output fell to 25.39 mbpd in May.

text.p: OPEC production in May fell 210,000 barrels a day (bpd) to 25.39 million from 25.60 million in April, member countries told OPEC headquarters in Vienna, OPEC news agency said on Friday.
OPEC supply to the market in May was 25.27 million bpd from 25.64 million in April, according to the OPEC secretariat report prepared from direct member country submissions.
OPEC measures quotas under its 25.03 million ceiling by supply rather than production.
Media estimates monitored by OPEC, including a Reuters survey, also showed OPEC output falling in May but still put production approaching 27 million bpd.
The report said the OPEC secretariat had revised down its projection on the call for OPEC crude on average this year by 100,000 bpd from last month's report to 25.30 million bpd.

It said had reduced its expectation for world demand this year by 60,000 bpd to 70.78 million from a month-earlier report and revised up its projection for non-OPEC supply by 40,000 bpd to 45.50 million.
